QuestInfo.name: Mother Knows Best
QuestInfo.0: Phyllia is against Keeny's dream of becoming an alchemist but something might change her mind...
QuestInfo.1: Phyllia decides to help Keeny with her dream and asks that you go get a book on alchemy from #bHan the Broker#k for Keeny.
QuestInfo.2: You deliver the basic alchemy book to Keeny as Phyllia requested. Keeny can now work hard on her dream of being an alchemist with the support of her parents.

0.0: It was you wasn't it? You're the one that brought the entry pass to Keeny and brought her the stuff for her experiments. \r\n#L0##bUhhh... That's...#l\n#k
0.1: Did you think I wouldn't find out? Moms know everything about their children. And Keeny... I raise her right and she STILL wants to be an alchemist? \r\n#L0##bIt's her dream, you know.#l\n#k
0.2: Well...if it was just her curiosity, I would stop her. But if she really wants it THAT much, I guess I have no choice. In the end, kids always get what they want. So let's help her out.

yes.0: She will need a proper book to study from if she wants to commit to alchemy. I heard #bHan the Broker#k can get anything, so go get a book from him and deliver it to Keeny. Oh, and have Han bill me for it.

no.0: This all started because you helped her. You have to see this through!

1.0: Mother sent a gift? N-no way! It's not a spanking or anything like that is it?

yes.0: A #r#t4033856##k?! Mother sent this? Mother...she finally approves of my dreams!

default.0: I want to be an awesome alchemist like my father!

npc.0: No parent can win when it comes to their children. I have no choice but to support Keeny's dreams.
